title: PGuard: A Native, Streaming, and Plug-in Guardrail for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.02791v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As streaming generation becomes the dominant serving paradigm for both text-only and multimodal large language models, ensuring safety throughout the generation process has become a critical challenge. We introduce PGuard, a native, streaming, and plug-in guardrail that transforms safety monitoring from an external serving dependency into an integrated capability of the backbone model. PGuard directly leverages the backbone's intermediate representations for token-level safety detection, without altering its original inference pathway or generation behavior. Specifically, dynamic layer gating selectively aggregates residual-stream representations across layers to extract safety-relevant signals during both prefill and autoregressive decoding. To balance detection accuracy and computational efficiency, PGuard supports multiple representation-modeling architectures, including a lightweight stateless variant and sequence-aware variants buil

translated_title: PGuard：一种面向多模态大语言模型的原生、流式、即插即用安全防护栏
translated_abstract: 随着流式生成成为纯文本和多模态大语言模型的主导服务范式，在整个生成过程中确保安全性已成为一项关键挑战。我们提出了 PGuard，这是一种原生的、流式的、即插即用的安全防护栏，它将安全监控从外部服务依赖转变为骨干模型的内生集成能力。PGuard 直接利用骨干模型的中间表示进行 token 级别的安全检测，而不会改变其原始推理路径或生成行为。具体而言，动态层门控机制选择性地聚合跨层的残差流表示，从而在预填充和自回归解码阶段提取与安全相关的信号。为了平衡检测精度与计算效率，PGuard 支持多种表示建模架构，包括轻量级的无状态变体以及基于序列感知的变体……
tldr: PGuard 是一种面向多模态大语言模型的原生、流式、即插即用安全防护栏，它通过动态层门控直接利用骨干模型的中间表示实现 token 级安全检测，无需改变模型的原始推理路径即可将安全监控内化为模型自身能力。
en_tdlr: PGuard is a native, streaming, and plug-in guardrail for multimodal LLMs that leverages the backbone's intermediate representations through dynamic layer gating for token-level safety detection, transforming safety monitoring into an integrated model capability without altering the original inference pathway.
